stories.story_fr: Net income de 461 millions de dollars au premier trimestre 2026, en hausse par rapport aux 204 millions de dollars du même trimestre 2025.
stories.story_en: Net income of $461 million in Q1 2026, up from $204 million in Q1 2025.
stories.quote: Halliburton Company announced today net income of $461 million, or $0.55 per diluted share, for the first quarter of 2026.

stories.story_fr: Operating income de 679 millions de dollars au premier trimestre 2026, contre 431 millions de dollars au même trimestre 2025.
stories.story_en: Operating income of $679 million in Q1 2026, versus $431 million in Q1 2025.
stories.quote: Operating income was $679 million in the first quarter of 2026, compared to operating income of $431 million in the first quarter of 2025.

stories.story_fr: Le PDG signale des signes clairs d'une reprise précoce en Amérique du Nord.
stories.story_en: The CEO signals clear signs of an early‑stage recovery in North America.
stories.quote: In North America, I see clear signs that we are in the early innings of a recovery.

stories.story_fr: Les performances internationales ont surpassé les perturbations liées au conflit au Moyen‑Orient.
stories.story_en: International performance outpaced disruptions from the Middle East conflict.
stories.quote: In international markets, our performance around the world outpaced disruptions from the Middle East conflict.

stories.story_fr: Halliburton a racheté environ 100 millions de dollars d'actions au premier trimestre 2026.
stories.story_en: Halliburton repurchased roughly $100 million of shares in Q1 2026.
